content.short: IceCreamSwap is an AI-powered DEX aggregator that finds the best swap route across many chains.
content.description: IceCreamSwap is a DEX and aggregator that routes trades through thousands of DEXes indexed by Nordstern Finance across more than 100 chains to find the best rate. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists it, and growthepie labels IceCreamSwap contracts on Unichain.
content.meta: IceCreamSwap is an AI-powered DEX aggregator across 100+ chains, including Unichain.
